pnpm.//overrides: Supply-chain + critical/high RCE floors (audit 2026-06-08, refreshed 2026-06-13, see SECURITY_AUDIT.md). (1) @tanstack/* floors keep the 2026-05-11 Shai-Hulud worm versions (CVE-2026-45321: react-router/router-core 1.169.5-1.169.8, history 1.161.9-1.161.12) from ever resolving. (2) protobufjs >=8.0.1 patches GHSA-xq3m-2v4x-88gg (arbitrary code execution) via OpenTelemetry → grpc. (3) minimatch >=9.0.5 patches three ReDoS advisories via drizzle-kit's glob chain. (4) fast-uri >=3.1.2 patches path-traversal + host-confusion advisories via Hono → ajv. (5) lodash >=4.18.0 patches GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc (template code injection) via bull-board + dagre. (6) esbuild >=0.28.1 patches missing-binary-integrity advisory (Deno module RCE via NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY — we use the Node path so impact is theoretical, but the audit flags by version). (7) @grpc/grpc-js >=1.14.4 patches GHSA-5375-pq7m-f5r2 (CVE-2026-48068, malformed HTTP/2 stream server crash) and GHSA-99f4-grh7-6pcq (CVE-2026-48069, malformed compressed message client/server crash) — both transitive via OpenTelemetry's OTLP/gRPC exporters. (8) brace-expansion + yaml + ws + uuid address DoS / memory-disclosure / bounds-check advisories in transitive deps. (9) Audit 2026-11-14: raised the protobufjs, minimatch, fast-uri, @grpc/grpc-js and brace-expansion floors to their current patched versions. The `name@<range>` entries only replace versions inside the vulnerable range and keep the parent on the same major: vite (launch-editor on Windows), @fastify/busboy and @graphql-tools/* (via graphql-yoga and GraphQL Mesh), js-yaml, nanoid, postcss, source-map-js, undici (via cheerio and vitest), seroval (via @tanstack/react-router), browserslist, baseline-browser-mapping, sharp (via @xenova/transformers, which pins 0.32) and glob (via gaxios, pulled in by the OpenTelemetry GCP resource detector). The unscoped vite floor was replaced by the ranged one so a re-resolve cannot jump workbench-core to a new vite major.
